title: Spark Ads Video Templates for TikTok | AIVideosUGC
description: Create a TikTok Spark Ads video from one product photo. Show an everyday product moment, add your caption and offer after download, then post from your account.
h1: Spark Ads Style Video You Can Post on TikTok
lead: Place your product photo in an everyday scene, post the file from your own TikTok account, and add the caption there.
steps_h2: Make a Native TikTok Ad in 3 Steps
steps_lead: You get a product clip. Posting, sound, and the Spark authorization happen in TikTok.

steps.d: Upload one clear photo with the full product in view. Keep the detail the TikTok moment needs.
Describe one everyday action, then pick 9:16 and 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. The campaign stays in TikTok Ads Manager.
Download the file, post it from your TikTok account, and finish authorization in Ads Manager. Add the caption there.

faq.q: What is a Spark Ads style video?
faq.a: A vertical product clip you can post from your own TikTok account and then authorize for promotion. This page makes the footage. It does not create the ad campaign.

faq.q: How do I make the clip?
faq.a: Upload one product photo, describe one everyday action, choose 9:16 and a length, then download.

faq.q: Does this publish a Spark Ad for me?
faq.a: No. Download the file, post it from your account, and finish authorization and campaign setup in TikTok Ads Manager.
TikTok sellers and teams who want product footage without booking a creator shoot, including food and electronics shops.

faq.q: Will it include captions or trending audio?
faq.a: No. Add captions, a spoken line, sound or an offer in TikTok or your editor after download.
One clear photo with the full product visible and the detail the moment needs to show.

faq.q: Which size and length should I pick?
faq.a: 9:16 matches a full-screen TikTok post. Lengths are 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds. 1:1, 16:9, 4:3 and 3:4 are available when the placement is not full screen.

faq.q: Do I need to write a long script?
faq.a: Pick a scene and describe the action in one or two lines. Add the TikTok caption yourself after download.
24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15 and 120 for 30. You see the cost first. A failed job returns its credits. Plans start at $24.50 a month.
Yes, after you post it from your own account and complete TikTok's authorization. The download has no watermark. Any person on screen is an AI performer, not a customer.

picker.title: Choose a Scene for a TikTok Spark Ads Creative
picker.lead: Open a product scene you can post from your own TikTok account. Add the caption after download.

cards.label: ASMR Unboxing: Makeup Tools
cards.prompt: A seller can open with a close unboxing that lifts your makeup tools from tissue paper and puts the brush set in clear view.

cards.label: Cinematic Watch Detail
cards.prompt: A cinematic close-up can hold your watch in warm light while the camera glides across its face and strap.

cards.label: Bedroom Try-On: Knitwear
cards.prompt: Show your knitwear in a bedroom try-on as the creator turns in the mirror so the fit and sleeves stay visible.

cards.label: Street Style: Linen Set
cards.prompt: Take your linen set outdoors for a street-style walk that shows the fabric, movement and full silhouette.

cards.label: Lifestyle App Recommendation
cards.prompt: A creator can recommend your app from a real kitchen table while tapping through a clean, abstract interface on a phone.

cards.label: Streamer Reaction: App
cards.prompt: Use a streamer-style reaction to show the moment your app surprises a viewer, with the device screen kept clear and easy to follow.

cards.label: Routine Demo: Cream
cards.prompt: Film a quick morning routine where a creator opens your cream jar and applies it at a bright vanity.

cards.label: Bathroom Review: Moisturizer
cards.prompt: Let a creator give a direct bathroom review while holding your moisturizer beside his face and turning the jar toward the camera.

cards.label: GRWM Unboxing: Knitwear
cards.prompt: Build a get-ready moment around opening your knit sweater parcel and holding the full garment up before styling it.

cards.label: Mirror Selfie: Denim
cards.prompt: A mirror selfie can show your denim overshirt from collar to hem as the creator checks the fit before heading out.

cards.label: 360 Showcase: Linen Shirt

cards.label: Street Interview: Fitness Gear

cards.label: Talking Head: Skin Lesson

cards.label: POV Discovery: Court Gear

A home shop shows a charging cable routed through a desk tray, with the cable easy to see.
A food shop shows one pour on a kitchen counter, then adds the caption in TikTok.
A beauty shop shows one step of a routine, then adds the caption in TikTok.
A shoe shop holds one shoe at the ankle so the pair stays visible in the vertical frame.
A pet shop shows a leash clipped on in a hallway. Sound is added after download.

A drinkware shop shows the lid opened and the bottle raised, then types the offer in TikTok.
